Home.overviewDesc: Founded upon Hung Thinh Phat (HTP) Cooperative's steadfast commitment to clean Vietnamese agricultural supply, Long Gia was born to elevate Tien River dragon fruits. Partnering with local farmers across 115 hectares of GLOBALG.A.P., VietGAP, and 4-star OCOP certified orchards, HTP delivers fresh produce with high volume capacity, competitive pricing, and export-grade quality.

About.heroDesc: From Cho Gao's fertile dragon fruit plantations, Hung Thinh Phat develops a transparent, clean agriculture supply chain aimed at international markets.
About.visionDesc: Hung Thinh Phat Clean Agriculture Cooperative aims to become a leading enterprise in raw material development, technology transfer, post-harvest processing, circular agriculture, and agricultural distribution across Vietnam and globally.
About.missionDesc: Walking hand in hand with Farmers, Consumers, Workers, Society, Agriculture, Environment, and the Nation.
About.valuesDesc: Three core values shape how Hung Thinh Phat nurtures every fruit, cares for consumers, and supports the local farming community.
About.partnerDesc: Hung Thinh Phat warmly welcomes import-export corporations, supermarket chains, wholesalers, and food distributors.

Products.heroDesc: Cultivated under GLOBALG.A.P. and VietGAP standards, processed and packaged within a HACCP-certified facility.
Products.specsDesc: Flexible packaging configurations tailored to international phytosanitary standards and market preferences.
Products.quoteDialogDesc: Please provide your requirements; our export sales team will get back to you within 24 business hours.

ProcessContact.processDesc: Ensuring dragon fruits retain their crisp sweetness, vibrant red peel, and firm green bracts upon arrival at global destinations.
